old_quote: Gaussian case: P(sqrt n s_n <= t) = 1 - exp(-t^2/2 - t)
correction: H(t)=1-exp(-t-t^2/2) is the limiting real Gaussian hard-edge CDF as n tends to infinity, not the exact finite-n Gaussian CDF. Keep the finite-n Gaussian CDF in comparisons.
counterexample: At n=1, s_min(G_1)=|Z| with CDF erf(t/sqrt(2)); its right derivative at zero is sqrt(2/pi), not one. At t=1, 0.6826894921 differs from H(1)=0.7768698399.
